quote_original: God, the creator of all life, is like pure imagining in you, underlying all of your faculties – including perception.
context_before: Soon after this, a friend asked Ben to pray for him. He wanted to be the property manager of the company he worked for. Although he had been passed by year after year, Bennie told him what to do, and imagined hearing the friend tell him the job was now his. A few months later the job was vacated and his friend was given the position with an increase in salary and greater responsibility, just as he had imagined. What did Bennie do? He imagined! To whom did he pray? To his own wonderful human imagination!
context_after: He streams into your surface mind least disguised in the form of productive fantasy. Bennie took a stand. He prayed for his friend and believed his prayer was answered. He tested himself, and the windows of heaven opened and poured forth blessings for all to see. Now Bennie knows that with God all things are possible.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Yours For The Taking (1967-09-18).

quote_original: Emptying himself, God took on the form of a slave and is now found in the likeness of man.
context_before: God is your mightier self.
context_after: Abdicating his power, Pure Imagination took upon himself the limitations of flesh, thereby becoming human. The one who conjures thoughts in the mind of a Hitler or Stalin is the same power as the one conjuring thoughts in the mind of a pope or the Arch Bishop of Canterbury. There aren’t two Gods. There is only one!
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Yours For The Taking (1967-09-18).
